causal_feature_check: All ten variants use the registered completed-bar feature pool; no future price, oracle value, or hindsight winner is an input.
target_check: Runner derives all eight action values from contiguous matured 3/5/10/20-bar futures and subtracts $6 stressed round-trip cost from the worse of immediate and delayed fill. Losing alternatives remain in the target matrix.
alignment_check: Three purged chronological folds; fitted and scored arrays share the same boolean candle masks.
limitations: Very low hindsight-oracle imitation despite a small positive rank score; oracle acts with future information and is not a live benchmark.
No trade replay, gap-exit profit sensitivity, session concentration, or live API model artifact is produced at this selection stage.
The proposed feature set is in the current paper feature schema, but API parity still needs model serialization and a live decision-path check.
Existing source contract, roll, and timestamp conventions are not independently verified; no qualification or profitability claim follows.
